description: This file defines the ImageImporterJpeg class, which is responsible for importing JPEG images by parsing JPEG file headers and extracting image metadata such as dimensions, DPI, and color format within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: ImageImporterJpeg
classes.description: Main class for importing JPEG images, implementing header parsing and metadata extraction.

classes.name: ImportedImageJpeg
classes.description: Represents a JPEG image that has been imported, encapsulating image data and metadata preparation.

classes.name: ImageDataDct
classes.description: Holds the binary data of a JPEG image for PDF processing.

classes.name: ImagePrivateDataDct
classes.description: Private data container for JPEG images, including image byte data and size.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Attempts to import a JPEG image from the provided stream by verifying headers and reading metadata.

methods.name: TestFileHeader
methods.description: Checks if the stream's data starts with JPEG's SOI marker (0xffd8).

methods.name: TestJfifHeader
methods.description: Searches for JFIF, EXIF, App2, or App13 headers within the stream to identify JPEG-compatible headers.

methods.name: TestJfifHeaderWorker
methods.description: Checks for specific JFIF header identifier and properties, extracting DPI and aspect ratios.

methods.name: TestExifHeaderWorker
methods.description: Detects EXIF headers and verifies for EXIF signature.

methods.name: TestApp2HeaderWorker
methods.description: Detects ICC_PROFILE embedded data in APP2 headers.

methods.name: TestApp13HeaderWorker
methods.description: Detects Photoshop APP13 headers, specifically Adobe Photoshop IRB markers.

methods.name: TestColorFormatHeader
methods.description: Analyzes the Start of Scan (SOS) header to determine image color format and component count.

methods.name: TestInfoHeader
methods.description: Parses SOF headers (Start of Frame) for image dimensions and component info.

methods.name: MoveToNextHeader
methods.description: Advances the stream to the next header block based on current header's length.

methods.name: PrepareImage
methods.description: Not implemented; would prepare image data for PDF embedding.

methods.name: PrepareImageData
methods.description: In ImportedImageJpeg, converts private data into ImageData suitable for PDF.
